skiff_easels.description: a small wooden rowing skiff floating on water, Stardew Valley pixel art, seen from three-quarters above like the Night Market boats, bow pointing left, empty space in the middle of the boat for one person to stand. Painted deep teal with a gold trim line and little painted stars along the hull. On board: two small easels holding paintings, a stack of framed canvases, a lantern on a short pole at the stern glowing warm. No people, no water drawn around it. Transparent background.

skiff_gallery.description: a little floating art stall: a narrow wooden boat, Stardew Valley pixel art, three-quarter top-down view like the Night Market vendor boats, bow to the left. The hull is midnight blue with silver crescent moons painted on its side. Inside: a low wooden counter at the front with picture frames leaning on it, a small easel with a painting at the back, a string of two paper lanterns. An empty spot in the middle for the stall keeper to stand. No people. Transparent background.
